label: Robust WLS multilateration
inputs: one frame: anchor_xyz, tag-anchor ranges, anchor delays, anchor sigmas, optional x0 initial guess, tag_delay
range_aggregation: caller supplies per-frame ranges or pre-aggregated static range; no aggregation in C core
loss: Huber by default; current code supports Huber/Tukey and Python exposes linear, but C validation currently resets non-Huber/Tukey to Huber
weights: anchor_sigma; min_sigma=5 mm; Huber f_scale currently 30 mm if configured
optimizer: custom Gauss-Newton normal equations, max_iters=8, max_step=500 mm, convergence=0.02 mm
initialization: previous solution if provided, otherwise centroid of active anchors
outputs: x/y/z, residuals_by_anchor, used mask, RMS/P95/max residual

label: Quality-aware robust WLS
inputs: same as T1 plus quality_percent and quality EMA
weights: effective_sigma = anchor_sigma * quality_penalty; quality penalty uses current/EMA quality, cap=4
key_difference: soft downweights weak-quality anchors; no rejection

label: Dynamic-stable robust WLS
inputs: same as T2 plus residual_ema_abs and previous solution x0
weights: quality penalty plus residual-memory penalty for anchors with residual EMA above 120 mm; cap=2.5
optimizer: Gauss-Newton plus weak previous-position prior with temporal_prior_sigma=180 mm when x0 exists
outputs: same as T1 plus temporal behavior through wrapper memory
key_difference: adds dynamic smoothing/stability and residual-memory soft downweighting for low-redundancy motion

label: Adaptive redundancy policy / current dynamic candidate
method_id: 4 in C; Python policy wraps it
range_aggregation: caller supplied; full-anchor static work often uses p50/lower_trim outside solver
d_tag: same as T1; LOO calibrated in analyses, e.g. 49.621 mm V5
loss: same configured robust loss; default Huber 30 mm after recent change
weights: if n>=8, Python wrapper calls memory-free T1 config; if n<8, uses T3-style quality/residual EMA and temporal prior
initialization: full-anchor path ignores prior; low-redundancy path uses previous solution
key_difference: avoids temporal memory when all 8 anchors are present, preserving responsiveness while retaining T3 stability under dropout

label: accelerometer-gated T4 policy variant
inputs: same as T4 plus parsed IMU summary: imu_valid, sample count, acc_norm_std_mg
weights: same as T4; when n<8 and valid IMU, temporal_prior_sigma is divided by sqrt(prior_scale) where prior_scale=exp(-ln2*sigma_acc/0.5)
optimizer: same C Gauss-Newton; wrapper adjusts config per frame
outputs: same as T4 plus imu_prior_scale and temporal_prior_sigma_used metadata
key_difference: weakens temporal prior during detected motion; falls back to T4 when IMU missing
